_comment: Claude Desktop MCP configuration for josh-personal tenant. Merge into ~/.config/claude/claude_desktop_config.json (Linux) or ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS). OMNIMIND_MCP_AGENT_KEY is the omk_ key printed by keygen for THIS agent (sent as x-agent-key); OMNIMIND_API_KEY is the shared service key.
